title: Menstruation (Periods)
summary: A period is the monthly shedding of the uterine lining through the vagina when pregnancy hasn't happened. Cycles typically last 21–35 days, with bleeding for about 2–7 days.
key_points: Cramps are common; severe pain or very heavy bleeding should be checked.
Sex during a period is safe if both people are comfortable; pregnancy and STIs are still possible.
